_comment: A FAST RUN. Wear it, do not live in it:
scanplan plan --station input/station.json --config configs/fast.json --out output/fast
Why it exists: iterating on the joint model needs a path every couple of minutes, not
every half hour. Measured on the 1.05 m2 real part (2026-10-28, same command, one key
changed): 3 mm / face auto = 1724 s, 10 mm / face auto = 223 s. Dropping to one face
halves that again - both changes are in this file.
sample_grid_mm   3 -> 10   the target is sampled 11x more coarsely, and the coverage
cost is ~ (poses x samples) in both the pose and the stroke
stage. This is the whole speedup; nothing else here is.
face             auto -> upper   `auto` plans BOTH faces and keeps the better one, so
it costs double. A fast run does not need that comparison.
What is deliberately NOT here:
stroke.check_step_mm / extend_step_mm   they look like an easy 1.5-2.5x, but
check_step_mm is also the step the joint screen samples a straight move at,
so coarsening it would make the check coarser than the motion it checks.
stroke.enabled = false   the J5 over-travel this work is chasing happens ALONG the
straight sweep, so a path without sweeps cannot reproduce it.
fast.no_occlusion = true   do not turn on by default. It stops testing lines of
sight, so a pose can 'cover' a sample through the part. Worth ~10-15% only.
These numbers are for the SHAPE of the path. They are not an acceptance result: the
report says so in `fast_mode`, in `scope`, and on the console as a FAST MODE line.
